scope: Step89 corrected principal algebra and spectral-support checks

normalization.C_convention: C_ab=omega_a^+ o omega_b^- as trace-free involutions, tr(C_ab C_cd)=4 delta_ac delta_bd
normalization.V2_convention: smooth tensor expansion h=V0 + V2 + O(r^4), V2=(1/2) H_ijpq x_p x_q with H=d_p d_q h_ij(0)
normalization.receiver_formula: R_odd=(delta R^+_22 - delta R^-_22)/2, where delta R^pm_22 is the curvature-operator matrix entry in the normalized SD/ASD basis (omega/sqrt(2)); delta R_ijkl=1/2(h_il,jk+h_jk,il-h_ik,jl-h_jl,ik)
normalization.correct_identity: S_odd(V2) = (pi^2/2) R_odd(H), where V2=(1/2)H_ijpq x_p x_q
normalization.equivalent_tensor_relation: D:H = -16 R_odd (Hessian variables); D:V = -8 R_odd (polynomial coefficient variables)
normalization.step88_factor_issue: step88_source_receiver_proportionality used Hessian variables in the source contraction without the 1/2 converting H to V2, giving pi^2 instead of pi^2/2

shape_negative_mode_support.reason_for_zero: its quadratic metric expansion has tensor and derivative support inside one S^2 factor, so the fully mixed non-diagonal D contraction vanishes

relative_interaction_algebra.formula: Radial Delta_tau = sum_ij a_i b_j (epsilon_i epsilon_j - 1) K_ij^odd(tau) with a_i=t_i receiver weight and b_j=t_j^2 source weight. A purely energy-like comparison may use w_i w_j, but it is not Ozuch radial order. Diagonal odd-odd factors vanish before tau->0.
relative_interaction_algebra.interpretation: relative comparison cancels common odd-odd self singularities algebraically; sign of the finite off-diagonal limit is not implied by positivity of a regularized full matrix. Even-odd and odd-even diagonal terms require separate symmetry or renormalization.

order_bookkeeping.inter_node_term: t_i t_j^2 = O(t^3) for comparable scales
order_bookkeeping.comparison: t^3 is smaller than t^(5/2) as t->0, so Proposition 2.19 cannot decide this layer without a sharper projected expansion
